svg.text: From the full α₂β₂ receptor → the six ectodomain modules → the L1 design target

g.text: Numbering: mature IR-A (27-aa signal peptide removed). IR-B (+12 aa from exon 11, within αCT): α 1–731, RKRR 732–735, β 736–C-term.
Sources: PNAS 2010 (PMID 20348418); Cys647–Cys860: Sparrow et al. 1997 (cited in IR/IGF-1R literature); encyclopedia.pub/entry/17749.

svg.text: schematic cartoon of the L1 fold (β-strands + loops), not a real structure
Design target: residues E6 – E155 (150 aa)

g.text: • Leucine-rich-repeat domain: single-stranded right-handed β-helix fold
• Part of insulin Site 1 (L1 central β-sheet + αCT 704–719 of the α-chain)
• Tutorial goal: design a de novo binder against this L1 segment
